g.title: python_gui_architecture
g.text: AERIS-10 - Python GUI runtime architecture: GUI_V5.py (last complete hardware GUI) and GUI_V6_Demo.py (offline simulator)
Drawing ID: SD-06 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: SOURCE-DERIVED - drawn only from class/method names and call sites in the two files; nothing was executed

g.title: cluster_v6
g.text: GUI_V6_Demo.py - offline simulator (no USB, no threads; numpy + matplotlib + tkinter only)

g.title: legend
g.text: blue = GUI/application class or method (line numbers = definition or call site in the named file); green = thread or Tk-timer callback;
orange = present but cannot work against the actual hardware or protocol (documented in docs/GUI/DEPENDENCIES.md); grey = defined/imported but not used at runtime
Third-party at runtime: GUI_V5.py -> numpy, matplotlib(TkAgg), scipy(imported only), scikit-learn + filterpy (inside never-called methods), crcmod, pyusb (optional), pyftdi (optional)
GUI_V6_Demo.py -> numpy, matplotlib(TkAgg) only (plus stdlib tkinter, json, random, datetime, platform)
VERIFIED: ast parse of both files (tools/gen_python_module_graph.py), grep of call sites listed above. NOT VERIFIED: GUI launch, hardware I/O, timing of threads
